name: us_treasury_fiscaldata-mcp
description: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data (market data): get_series. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Monthly average interest rate (percent) of one kind of Treasury security. series_id is the security description exactly as published, e.g. 'Treasury Bills', 'Treasury Notes', 'Treasury Bonds', 'Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS)', 'Total Marketable'. start/end are YYYY-MM-DD.
